name: session-artifact-relay
description: Relay of session artifacts (files produced for the user) to the Discord session channel: PostToolUse capture of SendUserFile, payload extraction, and attachment egress through Concordia chat with a text fallback when the attachment is refused.
cardTemplate: Summarise the session-artifact-relay domain: a file handed to the harness must also reach the remote viewer, or say why it could not.
rationale: SendUserFile succeeds locally even when the remote viewer receives nothing, so the relay exists to close that silent gap. The relay never decides what is worth sending; it forwards what the tool was given and, when Concordia refuses the attachment, reports the reason instead of dropping it.
